Project: ABVX Lab
Canonical URL: https://lab.abvx.xyz/
Repository: https://github.com/markoblogo/lab.abvx

Purpose:
ABVX Lab is the public hub for the ABVX repo and workflow layer around
AI-assisted coding. It presents the core stack: SET, agentsgen, ID, repomap,
LWP, and ABVX Agent Skills.

Primary surfaces:
- Home: https://lab.abvx.xyz/
- agentsgen: https://lab.abvx.xyz/tools/agentsgen/
- SET: https://lab.abvx.xyz/tools/set/
- ID: https://lab.abvx.xyz/tools/id/
- ABVX Agent Skills: https://lab.abvx.xyz/tools/abvx-agent-skills/
- Repo cards: https://lab.abvx.xyz/repos/
- Planning queue: https://lab.abvx.xyz/planning/
- Proof queue: https://lab.abvx.xyz/proof/
- Integration declaration: https://lab.abvx.xyz/.well-known/integrations.json
- Agent card: https://lab.abvx.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json

Canonical product discovery:
- agentsgen product site: https://agentsmd.abvx.xyz/
- agentsgen integrations: https://agentsmd.abvx.xyz/.well-known/integrations.json
- agentsgen agent card: https://agentsmd.abvx.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json

Local run:
- python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory docs

Notes:
ABVX Lab is a static GitHub Pages catalog. Product-specific runtime or CLI
instructions live on the product pages and their own discovery files.
